1479-2375-2841-8293.easyPrerequisites:
You're able to play a land this turn.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Riveteers Overlook.
1479-2375-2841-8293.description:
Fetch a land using Riveteers Overlook.
When the fetched land enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

277-1021-5412-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving it flying until end of turn.
Repeat.

147-1893-4247.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1893-4247.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-4050-5708.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

225-1308-4365-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

38-2316-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
38-2316-7824.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Skirk Prospector three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

889-1636-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
889-1636-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Deekah triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

4365-5660-6462-6753-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

1849-2034-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3330-4186-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3330-4186-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-3899-4068-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1563-3899-4068-6441.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

109-232-1018-1235.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Skullwinder.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Skullwinder with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Skullwinder tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Fork from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

436-5220-5241.description:
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Put Sakashima's Student into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Sakashima's Student dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Sakashima's Student from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put Sakashima's Student onto the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-2557-7060.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

132-3750-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures that share a creature type.
132-3750-7013.description:
Activate Myr Welder using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1579-2292-6972--112.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Visionary Augmenter.
When Visionary Augmenter dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Visionary Augmenter enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
1579-2292-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Visionary Augmenter's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1182-5220-6900.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Stonecoil Serpent enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

225-573-5451-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
225-573-5451-5702.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-573-5451-5702.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Gruul Turf.
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

969-5299-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
969-5299-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
969-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

1912-2060-5140-6627.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
1912-2060-5140-6627.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

478-539-4747--111.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 3 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
478-539-4747--111.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Alena.
Repeat.

2468-4084.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Part the Waterveil without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Part the Waterveil, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2825-5107.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2825-5107.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Rally of Wings and casting the copy without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control with flying +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2781-4393.description:
Cast Dance of Many by paying {U}{U}.
When Dance of Many enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Dance of Many.
Dance of Many's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, exiling the Felidar Guardian token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 3.

1849-2457-4094-4289.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1849-2457-4094-4289.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

245-647-1069-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
245-647-1069-5499.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

1580-2018-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Reassembling Skeleton from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni abilities from steps 1 and 5.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

930-3781-4050-4973.description:
Cast Universal Automaton from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {1}.
When Universal Automaton dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Resolve the Zask trigger, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

313-2034-2236.description:
Activate Witch Engine by tapping it, targeting any opponent.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Witch Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Witch Engine ability, adding {B}{B}{B}{B} and not giving control of Witch Engine to an opponent due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Witch Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat.

1242-2228-2744.notablePrerequisites:
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
It is your turn.
1242-2228-2744.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, causing target player to discard a card.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Hapatra triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
The Snake enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

57-1038-1402-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
57-1038-1402-2178.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Diamond Lion with haste.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Thornbite Staff and Stalking Vengeance both trigger.
Resolve the Vicious Shadows trigger, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
Resolve the Thornbite Staff trigger, untapping Feldon of the Third Path.
Repeat.

141-2292-2596.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2292-2596.description:
Cast Living Death by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Living Death.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Living Death
Resolve the Living Death copy, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, and returning all cards exiled this way to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Repeat from step 3.

147-413-1465.notablePrerequisites: You have a permanent card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-413-1465.description:
Cast Sevinne's Reclamation by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Sevinne's Reclamation.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Sevinne's Reclamation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Sevinne's Reclamation copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

224-573-1257.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.
